annotations.title: Move a scheduled post to a new time

description: Move one scheduled post to a new scheduledFor and timezone; nothing else about the post changes. Needs publish:post. Take the postId from soclo_posts_list.

scheduledFor.description: The new ISO date-time to publish at.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/London (defaults to Europe/London).

name: soclo_posts_reschedule
title: Move a scheduled post to a new time
